description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldparent_type, a widget for handling 'parent_type' enum fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. It extends the SugarWidgetFieldEnum class and provides a method for displaying list values, including rendering checkboxes based on field values.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldparent_type
classes.description: A widget class for rendering 'parent_type' fields, extends SugarWidgetFieldEnum, and adds custom display logic for list views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget and retrieves the reporter attribute from the layout manager.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns the display value for list views, rendering a disabled checkbox if the widget type is checkbox and the value indicates a true state.
